scenes.description: A high-tech underground laboratory filled with bubbling glowing cheese vats.
Cutaway: A boardroom meeting of pigeons wearing tiny business suits.
Back to the lab, where a giant toast launcher is being loaded.

dialogue.text: Deep inside Mount Cheddar, Dr. Bleep is about to unleash his most absurd culinary invention.
Witness the Gluten-ator! It turns ordinary oxygen into high-density brioche!
But Dr. Bleep! The pigeons! They have already weaponized the gluten-free alternative!
Meanwhile, at the avian syndicate headquarters...
Coo! Coo! We strike the bakery at dawn! Leave no crumb behind!
No! It is too late! The yeast has gained self-awareness! Run!
I always knew I would perish in a warm, buttery explosion! Goodbye, cruel world!
And so, humanity was saved, but at what cost? Mostly the cost of butter.
